title: Topic 1
japanese_text: 一人暮らしを始めた<u>当初</u>は毎日自炊を頑張っていたが、最近は<u>もっぱら</u>コンビニで朝昼<u>兼用</u>のご飯を買って食べ、夜は外食している。でも、<u>食材</u>が<u>余る</u>よりはきっといいはずだ。
english_translation: When I first started living alone I did my best to cook every day, but recently I exclusively buy my meals at the convenience store for both breakfast and lunch, and eat out at night. However, this is certainly better than having ingredients left over.

annotated_words.meaning_en: both, use for more than one purpose
